name: Talkies: Movie Ticket Diary
subtitle: Every film you watch, a ticket
promotionalText: 34,000+ films in 45 languages. Every viewing becomes a paper ticket stub with the hall, the seat, the show and the price. Free, offline, no ads, no account.
description:
Every film you watch becomes a paper ticket stub: the hall, the seat, the show, the price. One diary of everything you have seen, printed on coloured paper like an old single-screen ticket.

Free. No ads. No tracking. No account needed. Works offline.

EVERY WATCH IS A TICKET
• One stub per viewing, stamped WATCHED, with its own ticket number
• Rewatches get their own stub: second watch, third watch and more
• Rate in 0.1 steps, write notes, add unlimited tags
• Don't remember the date? Save only the month or the year

HALL DETAILS, THE INDIAN WAY
• Show: morning, matinee, evening or night
• Class: Balcony, Dress Circle, Box, Recliner, Gold
• Seat, price and format: IMAX, 4DX, ScreenX, Dolby Cinema, 3D
• An FDFS stamp for first day, first show
• Watched a dubbed version? Save the language you saw it in

34,000+ FILMS, EVEN OFFLINE
• Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Punjabi, Gujarati and more, plus web series and world cinema
• Search ignores spaces and punctuation, by title, actor, director or native script
• New releases and upcoming films, with a language filter
• See where a film streams
• Missing a film? Add it yourself with your own poster

YOUR YEAR IN FILMS
• Stats for any month, year or all time
• Watch time, money spent, FDFS count
• Top languages, genres, directors, actors, halls and formats
• Tap any bar to see its films

CALENDAR AND WATCHLIST
• A calendar of posters for every day you watched a film
• Plan a date for a film on your watchlist

WITH FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT
• An account is optional. Sign in with an email code, Google or Apple
• Sync your diary between phones
• Share a profile. New profiles are private, and dates are never shown
• Make a group, swipe on films together and pick one
• Plan a movie night: vote on a time, get reminders, chat
• Mark a stub private and nobody else sees it
• Report and block. Delete your account in Settings to remove all server data

MAKE IT YOURS
• The app in 45 languages
• Dark mode, 11 stamp ink colours, 5 app icons
• Share a ticket, a month or your stats as an image

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
• No account needed, no ads, no tracking
• Without an account your diary stays on your phone
• If you sign in, it also syncs to the Talkies server
• Import a CSV from another movie app. Export to CSV. Back up everything in one file

Every feature is free.
Film details come from Wikidata and Wikipedia.
whatsNew: The app now speaks 45 languages, from Hindi and Tamil to Arabic, Japanese and Portuguese. Pick yours in Settings. Ticket prices can show in your currency, and the whole app follows right-to-left languages. The diary, the stats and the tickets are unchanged.
